_comment: Budgeted labour cost as a percentage of sales, per location. These are the FY27 budget figures Ashley maintains, lifted from the Consolidated dashboard (consolidated.mezzascorecard.com, TB_STORES -> each entity's 'Labour %' row -> fy27). Peter asked for per-store targets rather than one network number, and the spread here is why: 21% at Halifax Shopping Centre against 31% at Mount Pearl is not variation in how well they are run, it is variation in what their volume can carry.
_refresh: Re-run scripts/extract-labour-targets.mjs against a fresh copy of consolidated/index.html whenever Ashley updates the budget. The FY27 monthly figures are flat, so the annual number is the monthly target.
_basis_check: Worth confirming with Ashley: the P&L Labour % denominator, and whether it includes payroll burden while Push's totalCosts may be wages only. Against FY26 P&L actuals our measure runs +0.6 points on average across the eight Corp stores and scatters both ways (-4.4 to +5.0), so there is no systematic gap of the kind a burden difference would produce -- but the periods are not the same, so this is reassurance rather than proof.
_note_mount_pearl: Mount Pearl is a franchisee location and its labour is not pulled from Push -- a franchisee's payroll is their own business. The target is kept here so it is ready if that ever changes, and so this file matches the Consolidated dashboard rather than quietly diverging.
